note: `updatedSince` is an RFC 3339 instant, never Unix seconds.
`statuses` are RegistrationStatus values; `attended` is not one in 0.1.
A page holds at most 100 items.
Unknown top-level payload member — the task lists the caller's own registrations only; there is no `entryId` to ask for someone else's.
